claim: MYR to EUR rate in June 2026 is about RM1 = €0.217.
Best time to visit Melaka is the drier months of April, May and October; hot and humid year-round at ~30C.
Dutch Square is the heart of Malacca's UNESCO core; the Stadthuys is the oldest Dutch building in the East and Christ Church (1753) is an active Anglican church.
St Paul's Church was built in 1521 by the Portuguese and is the oldest church in Southeast Asia, now a ruin on St Paul's Hill.
Porta de Santiago is the lone surviving gate of the A Famosa fortress; St Paul's is a 5-10 min walk up the hill and both are free.
The Baba & Nyonya Heritage Museum opens Wed-Mon (closed Tuesdays), 10:00-16:15 weekdays and 10:00-16:45 weekends.
The Jonker Street night market runs Friday-Sunday only, ~18:00 to midnight; no weekday market.
The Malacca River cruise is a 45-min loop running 09:00-23:00 every ~30 min, foreign adult ~RM30, and is best at night.
Masjid Selat Melaka (the Straits / floating mosque) sits on man-made Pulau Melaka, appears to float at high tide, and is best at sunset.
Ban Lee Siang on Jln Ong Kim Wee serves satay celup with a rich peanut sauce, evenings to midnight.
Hoe Kee (since 1962) is the locals' chicken-rice-ball pick with air-con and a shorter queue; Chung Wah is the old-school icon that sells out early.
Nancy's Kitchen is a 3rd-generation Peranakan (Nyonya) kitchen in Kota Laksamana, Malacca.
The Majestic Malacca is built around a restored 1920s Straits-Settlement mansion with original porcelain-tile flooring, on Jalan Bunga Raya in the UNESCO zone.
5 Heeren is a 10-room Peranakan museum-residence on Heeren Street, one of Melaka's finest heritage streets.
Hotel Puri is a restored 1822 Peranakan house on Heeren Street with a courtyard, offering heritage character at a modest price.
The Coco Journey is a coconut-grove farmstay at Klebang with transparent Eco Domes and Eco Tents for stargazing.
Buses from KL's TBS terminal to Melaka Sentral run ~every 30 min, fares from RM10-13, ~2-2.5h.
The Melaka Sentral to Penang Sentral direct bus is 7-8h, RM60-103, ~21 daily services; Penang Sentral is mainland, then ferry or taxi to George Town.
There is no direct bus from Malacca to the Cameron Highlands; all routings transfer at KL's TBS, ~7h20m or more.
Melaka On Bike's 3-hour countryside ride (15-20 km, all abilities) is RM140/person.
The Festa San Pedro runs 23-29 June with the feast on 29 June at the Portuguese Settlement.
For Chinese New Year 2026 Jonker Walk was strung with a record 2,026 lanterns.
